Markets.title: Market wrap:  Eternal Kotak Bank, HCL Tech, InterGlobe top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Thursday
Markets.summary: Indian equities ended a seven-session losing streak on Thursday as the Sensex surged 628 points and the Nifty gained 0.64%, driven by a relief in global bond yields. Market breadth turned positive, with analysts establishing key support levels between 24,000 and 24,100 and immediate resistance at 24,300.

Markets.title: Quote of the day by T. Rowe Price: "When picking a list of growth stocks for long-term investment, broad diversification of the risk is the first and most important principle to follow. No one can look ahead five or ten years and say what is the most promising industry or the best stock to own"
Markets.summary: T. Rowe Price emphasizes that diversifying risk is the most important principle when selecting growth stocks for long-term investment. Investors cannot reliably predict the best-performing industries or companies five to ten years in advance.

Markets.title: Jefferies favours two-wheeler stocks over four-wheeler stocks as earnings gap widens
Markets.summary: Jefferies prefers two-wheeler stocks over passenger vehicles because of stronger volume growth, resilient margins, and better earnings. The firm's top picks are TVS Motor Company and Eicher Motors, while it gives Underperform ratings to Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles and Hyundai Motor India.

Markets.title: Rupee spins wheels in thin band, shorts await fresh entry points
Markets.summary: The Indian rupee traded in a narrow range on Thursday due to central bank intervention maintaining currency stability. Analysts note that cautious speculators lean toward further depreciation while elevated oil prices pose ongoing risks for India's energy imports.

Markets.title: Is Bitcoin finally nearing a bottom? Bitwise CIO Matt Hougan answers
Markets.summary: Bitwise CIO Matt Hougan believes Bitcoin is nearing a market bottom due to subdued trading and a lack of sellers. He remains optimistic about the cryptocurrency's potential for upward volatility through the end of the year as it trades near $71,647.

Markets.title: Mom’s Belief operator files IPO papers with Sebi, to fund 319 new child therapy centres
Markets.summary: Mom’s Belief operator Rays of Belief has filed for an IPO to fund the opening of 319 new child therapy centres. The funds raised from the fresh issue of up to 52.30 lakh shares will support the expansion of its neurodevelopmental intervention services.

Geo-Political.title: At least 15 killed in Kyiv as Ukraine grapples with air defence shortages
Geo-Political.summary: A massive Russian air attack on Kyiv killed at least 15 people and targeted residential and industrial areas. The strikes occurred as Ukraine struggles with critical shortages of air defense systems.

Geo-Political.title: Founder of collapsed Chinese property giant Evergrande sentenced to life in prison
Geo-Political.summary: The founder of the collapsed Chinese property giant Evergrande has been sentenced to life in prison. His sentencing is a major development in the aftermath of the company's collapse, which heavily impacted China's real estate sector.

Geo-Political.title: Trump vows tougher economic measures on Iran and supporting countries
Geo-Political.summary: Following the expiration of a 60-day ceasefire without a diplomatic resolution, Donald Trump has promised harsher economic measures against Iran and its supporters. This escalation occurs as the ongoing conflict lacks any clear military or diplomatic off-ramp.

Geo-Political.title: Mushroom killer must stay in jail forever for 'truly dreadful' crime, appeal court told
Geo-Political.summary: Prosecutors are arguing that Erin Patterson's prison sentence is too lenient because it allows for potential parole. They contend that the convicted murderer must remain in jail forever due to the severity of her crime.

Geo-Political.title: Australia 'outraged' after Israel decides not to open criminal investigation into killing of aid worker in Gaza
Geo-Political.summary: Australia summoned the Israeli ambassador to express outrage after Israel decided not to launch a criminal investigation into the killing of aid worker Zomi Frankcom in Gaza. Foreign Minister Penny Wong called the decision insulting and inadequate.

Geo-Political.title: Missing teen hiker found dead in Australian bush after eight-day search
Geo-Political.summary: An eight-day search in the Australian bush for missing teenager Lily Hooper ended when she was found dead. The state premier initially misstated that she had been found alive before police confirmed her death.

AI & Tech.summary: An online course creator recently discovered that ChatGPT recommended their WordPress SaaS course as the top result without any paid advertising. This experiment demonstrates how AI recommendations are becoming a powerful new source of organic traffic alongside traditional SEO.

Data & Insights.title: RBI’s $50 billion boost may not be enough to lift the rupee | Here's why
Data & Insights.summary: India expects a $50 billion balance-of-payments surplus in FY27, yet experts warn it may not strengthen the rupee. This limited impact depends on whether the central bank's FCNR deposit inflows enter the market or are absorbed as reserves.

Data & Insights.title: RBI's rate-setting panel hints at future policy tightening if inflation persists
Data & Insights.summary: RBI Governor Malhotra stated that the central bank requires clearer evidence of persistent inflation before taking action. The Monetary Policy Committee indicated it may implement future policy tightening if high prices continue.

Data & Insights.title: Who pays, who profits — The economics of India's toll highways landscape
Data & Insights.summary: Data from the Indian Highway Management Company Limited reveals how high-traffic routes and FASTag annual passes are shaping India's toll revenue. The findings highlight the evolving economics of highway funding and shifting private sector involvement in the country's toll network.

Data & Insights.title: Ind-Ra raises India’s FY27 GDP growth estimate to 6.8%
Data & Insights.summary: India Ratings and Research has raised India's GDP growth estimate for the 2027 fiscal year to 6.8%. However, ongoing downside risks include the West Asia war, high inflation, a depreciating currency, and weaker-than-expected capital expenditure.

Data & Insights.title: Govt frontloads farm spending as El Nino risks cloud rural outlook
Data & Insights.summary: The Indian government is accelerating agricultural spending and fertilizer subsidies to protect rural incomes. This strategy aims to counteract the negative economic impacts of El Nino and a weak monsoon on the rural economy.

Data & Insights.title: $57 billion pours in, another $30 billion may follow: Indian economy eyes massive $50 billion surplus
Data & Insights.summary: SBI Research predicts India will achieve a $50 billion balance of payments surplus in fiscal year 2027. This projected surplus is driven by strong foreign currency inflows into the Indian economy.

India.title: Supreme Court Sets Up Panel To Probe Cop Action, Violence During NEET Protests
India.summary: The Supreme Court formed a panel to investigate police violence and actions during NEET protests. The inquiry will prioritize allegations of harassment against female protesters and severe injuries caused by police.

India.title: "PM Modi, Amit Shah Are Finished": Rahul Gandhi's Big Attack At Congress Meet
India.summary: At a Congress party meeting, Rahul Gandhi launched a severe attack by declaring that Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Amit Shah are finished. He also emphasized that the youth are the party's primary strength and stated that the Congress must work to protect their interests.

India.title: "My Sister Has Been Shot": YouTuber Pragya Mishra Mentioned In Killer Brother-In-Law's WhatsApp Status
India.summary: Manas murdered his wife Divya, who was the sister of YouTuber Pragya Mishra, and posted a WhatsApp status about the shooting. Manas then killed his own sister and committed suicide.

India.title: National Conference On Science Education: Free Registration, Travel, Accommodation
India.summary: A National Conference on Science Education is offering free registration, travel, and accommodation for attendees. Additionally, three outstanding oral presentations and three exceptional poster presentations will receive awards.

India.title: Jharkhand Government's Order Cancelling JPSC, JSSC Exams Stayed By High Court
India.summary: The Jharkhand High Court stayed the state government's order cancelling 22 recruitment examinations conducted by the JPSC and JSSC. The government had previously decided to scrap these exams based on CID and SIT investigation findings regarding alleged irregularities.

General.title: Prince Harry and Meghan moving back to UK later this month
General.summary: Prince Harry and Meghan are moving back to the United Kingdom later this month. Their children, Prince Archie and Princess Lilibet, are enrolled to start school in September.

General.title: Harry and Meghan are experts in surprise - but why are they returning to UK now?
General.summary: Prince Harry and Meghan Markle have made a sudden decision to return to the United Kingdom. This unexpected visit raises several questions for both the couple and the Royal Family.

General.title: Travelodge boss resigns as chain tackles security after sex assault at hotel
General.summary: Travelodge CEO Jo Boydell has resigned following criticism over the hotel chain's handling of safety and security issues. Her departure comes as the company works to improve security measures after a sexual assault occurred at one of its hotels.

General.title: School 'deeply saddened' by death of family in sea off Shoreham
General.summary: The Ellen Wilkinson School for Girls in Ealing has paid tribute to 14-year-old student Sara El-Khawas and her family following their deaths in the sea off Shoreham. The school expressed deep sadness over the tragedy that claimed the lives of Sara and her family members.

General.title: At least 15 killed in Kyiv as Ukraine grapples with air defence shortages
General.summary: At least 15 people were killed in Kyiv during a massive Russian airstrike on Thursday. The attack targeted apartment blocks and warehouses as Ukraine continues to face severe shortages of air defense systems.

General.title: Giant whales move into Greenland waters as ice disappears
General.summary: Climate change has melted sea ice in Greenland, creating new access for giant whales. These whales are now using the newly opened waters for feeding frenzies.
